news.title: Fed meeting live updates: Chairman Warsh says inflation is still too high
news.description: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point.

news.title: Fed approves interest rate hike, signals one more to come this year
news.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike since 2023 and indicated another to come.

news.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
news.description: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.
